title: Sichuan Wangcang Releases Ecological Documentary Encounter with the Ancient Trees, Documenting Millennium-Old Tree Conservation and Biodiversity Coexistence
description: Wangcang County, Sichuan - A new three-episode original ecological documentary, Encounter with the Ancient Trees, has been officially released. Created by photojournalists Hu Kun and Chen Jiapu, the film focuses on the diverse ancient tree communities in the Micang Mountains of the Qinba region, offering an objective portrayal of local practices in ancient tree protection, biodiversity conservation, and sustainable rural development.
